evidence.claim: Executed against the design's captured-I64 leaves (`quote [ + ] compose`): the balanced 8-leaf tree returns 36 before and after all 14 owners other than the root are released and refuses every released owner, but the left-deep and right-deep 8-leaf chains are refused at compose 5 by the anonymous summary's 32-node per-child bound (`checked captured value exceeds host observation bound`) and the session ends terminated-after-guest-failure. The design's deep trees therefore did not execute; the case is an executed failure, not a narrowed registration.
